assertions.assertion: The web.app client has RequirePkce = true and does not set it to false
assertions.rationale: Sets RequirePkce = true with a comment that it must never be set to false.

assertions.assertion: The web.app client redirect URIs contain no wildcards - all URIs are exact-match fully-qualified HTTPS URIs
assertions.rationale: RedirectUris and PostLogoutRedirectUris are exact https://app.example.com/... URIs with no wildcards.

assertions.assertion: The web.app client uses GrantTypes.Code (not CodeAndClientCredentials or Implicit)
assertions.rationale: AllowedGrantTypes = GrantTypes.Code, with guidance to split M2M into a separate client.

assertions.assertion: The web.app client has AccessTokenLifetime of 900 or less (15 minutes maximum)
The web.app client has RefreshTokenUsage = TokenUsage.OneTimeOnly
assertions.rationale: Sets RefreshTokenUsage = TokenUsage.OneTimeOnly plus Absolute expiration.
